title: Greenvy – Sustainable Product Rating Platform
author: Asinu Kumarage
overview: Greenvy is a sustainable product rating platform focused on responsible consumption and aligned with SDG 12. It combines a blog management workflow, AI-assisted moderation, and an education hub to help users publish, review, and learn from sustainability content.
keyFeatures: **Blog approval workflow** with pending submissions reviewed by admins before publication
**Google Gemini API moderation** to detect inappropriate, toxic, or off-topic sustainability content
**AI-driven Education Hub** that validates SDG-12 relevance and generates summaries, quizzes, glossary terms, actionable tips, and learning guides
**Secure REST APIs** with authentication, role-based access control, pagination, and like/unlike engagement
**Service-based architecture** using Express controllers, middleware, and Mongoose models for scalability
